title: Magma Caves

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Magma Trees, Burning Skull Quest, Flameslate, Burning Blossom(Petalfall quest)

body:
Description

The Magma Caves are a subarea of Mike's Mines, locked behind a rock wall that can be broken with explosives. Players can use three Small Bombs from Mike Miner's shop to gain access into this area. The Magma Caves are characterized by dark rock pillars, lava pools, and red patches of dirt.

Note that having a Healing Coil from the Classic Store, an Obsidian Skull, or a Fusion Coil is strongly recommended, as you will take damage when passing over lava pools. (driving skills are also required)

To get to the Magma Caves, go to Mike's Mines and try to follow the directions on the map next to the wall.

Lumberwork

At the deepest point of Magma Caves, players can find the spawn point for Magma Trees, Burning Blossoms and Ash Trees. Many of the sections in the Magma Caves require parkour, so it is difficult/near impossible for the player to bring their car to this point. It is recommended that players walk on foot to reach this area. While not necessary, a Gravity Coil and a Speed Coil (bought from the Classic Store) can prove helpful when traversing the Magma Caves.

  • Magma Trees are an especially profitable tree that can also spawn from meteorites. However, note that the Magma Caves are difficult to farm due to the sheer distance away from player spawn, so farming Magma Trees from this location is not as expedient as farming Mysterious Mushrooms.
  • When sanded, Magma Tree wood displays a neon orange color that is useful in making lava and futuristic builds. Ash Trees offer a deep black coloration that can be used for framing other colors.

Mining

Upon areas with red dirt/grass, two types of rock nodes can spawn: Lavaslate and Blackstone. On small islands in the lava lakes near the bottom of the caves, Flameslate nodes can also spawn. While not completely unique to this area, the rare ores for Magma Caves are:

  • Adurite, in Lavaslate nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
  • Palladium, in Blackstone nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
  • Obsidian, in Lavaslate and Blackstone nodes (but can also be found in Flameslate after Magmite freezes).
  • Rosa Flame Quartz, in Lavaslate nodes (but can spawn in other stone types).
  • Magmite, in Flameslate nodes only.

Note that Blackstone nodes have a dark coloration, making it difficult to see if any ores spawned in them. Moreover, the Magma Caves are dark, with a deeper black fog compared to Mike's Mines. A Flashlight from the Oak Depot is very useful in identifying any ores in the nodes.

Special Quests

As part of the Emberbane Axe quest, players can obtain the Burning Skull in this area. By placing a Skull next to a Magma Tree or lava pool, it will gradually redden and turn into a Burning Skull, used to unlock the Emberbane Axe.

Other

On the right side of Magma Caves there is another cave that leads to The Void.
